source: from pyspark.sql import functions as F

# CLEAN USERS CSV DATA
users_df = (
    spark.read
         .option("header", True)
         .option("inferSchema", True)
         .csv(f"{bronze_path}/users_data.csv")
)

users_clean_df = (
    users_df
    .withColumn(
        "per_capita_income",
        F.regexp_replace("per_capita_income", "[$,]", "").cast("double")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "yearly_income",
        F.regexp_replace("yearly_income", "[$,]", "").cast("double")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "total_debt",
        F.regexp_replace("total_debt", "[$,]", "").cast("double")
    )
    .withColumn("id", F.col("id").cast("long"))
    .withColumn("current_age", F.col("current_age").cast("int"))
    .withColumn("retirement_age", F.col("retirement_age").cast("int"))
    .withColumn("credit_score", F.col("credit_score").cast("int"))
    .withColumn("num_credit_cards", F.col("num_credit_cards").cast("int"))
    .dropDuplicates(["id"])
)
users_clean_df.write \
    .mode("overwrite") \
    .parquet(f"{silver_path}/users")

# CLEAN CARD CSV DATA

cards_df = (
    spark.read
         .option("header", True)
         .option("inferSchema", True)
         .csv(f"{bronze_path}/cards_data.csv")
)
cards_clean_df = (
    cards_df
    .withColumn("id", F.col("id").cast("long"))
    .withColumn("client_id", F.col("client_id").cast("long"))
    .withColumn(
        "credit_limit",
        F.regexp_replace("credit_limit", "[$,]", "").cast("double")
    )
    .withColumn("num_cards_issued", F.col("num_cards_issued").cast("int"))
    .withColumn(
        "acct_open_date",
        F.to_date("acct_open_date", "MMM-yy")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "expires",
        F.to_date("expires", "MMM-yy")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "has_chip",
        F.when(F.upper(F.col("has_chip")) == "YES", True)
         .when(F.upper(F.col("has_chip")) == "NO", False)
         .otherwise(None)
    )
    .withColumn(
        "card_on_dark_web",
        F.when(F.upper(F.col("card_on_dark_web")) == "YES", True)
         .when(F.upper(F.col("card_on_dark_web")) == "NO", False)
         .otherwise(None)
    )
    .dropDuplicates(["id"])
)

# SAVE AS
cards_clean_df.write \
    .mode("overwrite") \
    .parquet(f"{silver_path}/cards")

# Clean Transactions Data

transactions_df = (
    spark.read
         .option("header", True)
         .option("inferSchema", True)
         .csv(f"{bronze_path}/transactions_data.csv")
)

transactions_clean_df = (
    transactions_df
    .withColumn("id", F.col("id").cast("long"))
    .withColumn("client_id", F.col("client_id").cast("long"))
    .withColumn("card_id", F.col("card_id").cast("long"))
    .withColumn("merchant_id", F.col("merchant_id").cast("long"))
    .withColumn("mcc", F.col("mcc").cast("int"))
    .withColumn(
        "amount",
        F.regexp_replace("amount", "[$,]", "").cast("double")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "transaction_timestamp",
        F.to_timestamp("date", "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "transaction_date",
        F.to_date("transaction_timestamp")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "transaction_year",
        F.year("transaction_timestamp")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "transaction_month",
        F.month("transaction_timestamp")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "transaction_month_name",
        F.date_format("transaction_timestamp", "MMMM")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "transaction_type",
        F.when(F.col("amount") < 0, "Credit")
         .when(F.col("amount") > 0, "Debit")
         .otherwise("Zero")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "transaction_amount",
        F.abs(F.col("amount"))
    )
    .drop("date")
    .dropDuplicates(["id"])
)

# save in parquent format in silver
transactions_clean_df.write \
    .mode("overwrite") \
    .parquet(f"{silver_path}/transactions")

# Clean MCC Codes
import json

mcc_path = f"{bronze_path}/mcc_codes.json"

mcc_text = "\n".join(
    row.value for row in spark.read.text(mcc_path).collect()
)

mcc_dict = json.loads(mcc_text)

mcc_rows = [
    (int(mcc), category)
    for mcc, category in mcc_dict.items()
]

mcc_clean_df = spark.createDataFrame(
    mcc_rows,
    ["mcc", "category"]
)

# save in silver in parquet
mcc_clean_df.write \
    .mode("overwrite") \
    .parquet(f"{silver_path}/mcc_codes")

import json
# Clean Fraud Labels
fraud_path = f"{bronze_path}/train_fraud_labels.json"

fraud_text = "\n".join(
    row.value for row in spark.read.text(fraud_path).collect()
)

fraud_dict = json.loads(fraud_text)

# data frame
fraud_rows = [
    (int(transaction_id), label)
    for transaction_id, label in fraud_dict["target"].items()
]

fraud_labels_df = spark.createDataFrame(
    fraud_rows,
    ["transaction_id", "fraud_label"]
)

# Add a numeric flag

fraud_labels_df = (
    fraud_labels_df
    .withColumn(
        "is_fraud",
        F.when(F.col("fraud_label") == "Yes", 1)
         .otherwise(0)
    )
)

# save in silver (parquet)
fraud_labels_df.write \
    .mode("overwrite") \
    .parquet(f"{silver_path}/fraud_labels")
